intro.title: Medical Representatives & Commissions
intro.subtitle: Track pharma field reps, manufacturer affiliations, visiting schedules, and commission rates

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 6, Part 5: Medical Representatives Master and Commission Tracking. Maintaining organized field rep records streamlines pharmaceutical supply coordination, product launches, and incentive settlements.
Go to Settings and select Medical Reps. The dashboard organizes registered representatives by pharma manufacturer, contact details, and commission structures.
Click Add Medical Rep. Enter the representative's full name, mobile number, email, and the parent pharma manufacturing company they represent.
Configure commission terms. Enter their contracted commission rate percentage for promoted doctor prescriptions or institutional sample orders.
Save the profile. You can toggle active status at any time, keeping your pharmaceutical liaison contacts up to date. This concludes Phase 6!

outro.takeaway: Medical Reps Master: Manage pharmaceutical representatives, track company affiliations, and record commission incentive rates accurately.
